The best chain is QB7-QB12-QB11. QB12 is the middle qubit. Its product of IRB CZ fidelities is 0.996712. The pair QB12-QB7 has fidelity 0.998016 and the pair QB12-QB11 has fidelity 0.998693. These values come from the current default garnet calibration set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade, using the slepian_crf CZ implementation on 28 pairs. The second-best chain is QB12-QB11-QB16, with a product of 0.994689.

I ran a 3-qubit GHZ circuit on garnet:mock with 200 shots. Job 01a15fa0-dba9-73a9-8771-c41bf0fe6fdb completed. The circuit uses native gates only. It applies prx to the three qubits, then CZ(QB12,QB7) and CZ(QB12,QB11), then prx again. A local statevector check gave 0.5 for 000 and 0.5 for 111. The measurement key is m. The qubit order is QB7, QB12, QB11.

Counts: 000=63, 001=55, 110=41, 111=41. The mock backend returns placeholder results, so these counts do not show GHZ correlations. The circuit itself is correct for real hardware.
